subtitle: A Claude Code plugin for planning backcountry trips in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and the British Columbia.

heroImage.alt: Pipeline from itinerary through resolver, six research agents, hard stops, synthesizer and critic to a verdict
heroImage.caption: Deterministic Python solver decides per-day sources. Six agents return readings in parallel, each with a source and an as-of. Hard stops are evaluated from their structured signals and set a verdict floor. The synthesizer weighs what is left to generate a Go/No-Go verdict, and a critic sends it back once if a reading went missing.
